## Record failure
Called from every error branch. Marks the run failed, writes a dead letter with a reason code and whether a replay can fix it, and emails ops through the adapter. Nothing that fails here is ever silent: the dashboard lists the dead letter and offers a replay.

parameters.query: select jsonb_object_agg(key, value) as settings from settings;

with f as (select $1::jsonb as j),
failed_run as (
  update runs r set status = 'failed', error_code = f.j->>'error_code',
    error_detail = left(f.j->>'error_message', 2000), finished_at = now()
  from f
  where r.application_id = f.j->>'application_id' and r.status = 'processing'
  returning r.id
)
insert into dead_letters (application_id, run_id, source, error_code, error_detail, failed_node, workflow, retryable, n8n_execution_id)
select j->>'application_id', (select max(id) from failed_run), j->>'source', j->>'error_code',
  left(j->>'error_message', 2000), j->>'failed_node', j->>'workflow', (j->>'retryable')::boolean, j->>'execution_id'
from f
returning id, application_id, error_code;
